title: Custom Font displays ???'s for most characters

posts.author: DIYDylana
posts.body: Edit: My question is apparently not possible. I wanted to use my font, but it's only possible in later RPG Makers. RPG Maker XP doesn't use unicode encoding, so it can't display non Japanese characters without using Shift JIS encoding rather than UTF-16 and changing the windows system locale for it in the region/language settings. Sorry for wasting time!

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: RMXP uses UTF-8 encoding not 16 AFAIK...
